title: UMSF Incident Lab: standalone Colab notebook for evidence-aware multisensor analysis

creators.name: Beketova, Gulzhanat
creators.affiliation: Almaty University of Energy and Communications

description:
Self-contained English Google Colab/Jupyter research notebook with embedded source, synthetic data and tests. After a three-cell setup, every analysis cell is self-sufficient: it can run alone, in any order or after a kernel restart. Provides reproducible Study A/B analyses, extensive visualizations, an offline interactive incident explorer, bench and protocol demonstrations, service-allocation and storage experiments, and exported figures/tables.

Notebook release 1.2.0 preserves analytical core 1.0.0. Study A/B are independent synthetic re-implementations tuned to supplied manuscript aggregates, not independent empirical validation. Stage 1 is a bench transcription with a synthetic HR test field; Stage 2 is a synthetic re-enactment. No human-subject data. No clinical, structural, gas-identification or certified safety claims. Authors and affiliations are retained from the source package.
notes: Research software accompanying a manuscript; not a medical device or a certified safety, alarm or structural-monitoring system. No actuation. Included data are synthetic or a supplied bench transcription; no human-subject data. Study A/B are independent re-implementations of documented designs. Demonstration keys are not operational provisioning; orderly SQLite reopening is not an abrupt power-loss test. Notebook and documentation language: English (eng). Local execution of all cells, sequentially and each cell alone in a fresh kernel, is verified; the hosted Google Colab interface has not been tested.
references: Torstensson O., Prokopovych-Tkachenko D., Adilzhanova S., Tykhonenko M., Beketova G., Sydybayeva M. Evidence-Aware Multisensor Monitoring for Critical Infrastructure Incident Support: System architecture and preliminary verification using synthetic evaluations and bench demonstrations. Manuscript, 2026.
